record.question: He was not so ill as we had thought. Identify the adverbial clause type.
record.explanation: Answer C: Comparison. “As we had thought” compares the actual degree of illness with what was expected. Independent check: “Not so … as we had thought” compares the degree of illness with an expectation; the clause is comparative. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/comparatives-and-superlatives. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
